thread:
Elaine R: Quick heads-up — noticed two issues on the geo landing page: the supported regions table still lists the deprecated alias `asia-east-1` and the JP translation of the 'data residency' footnote reads '保留' which is ambiguous. I've opened a small PR with fixes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/492
Marcus L: Linking — thanks. Can you paste the exact table row that's wrong so I can patch the SDK snippet in the python quickstart too?
Elaine R: Sure — current row: `| Asia Pacific (Tokyo) | asia-east-1 | Data may be routed outside JP` should be `| Asia Pacific (Tokyo) | ap-northeast-1 | Data stored in JP region, subject to residency controls`.
Jordan P: Re: SDK snippet — I saw the python example still uses `region='asia-east-1'`. Proposed replacement:
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(region='ap-northeast-1', api_key=REDWOOD_API_KEY)
```
Can we standardize on `ap-northeast-1` across all samples?
docs-bot: linter report: link broken -> /legal/residency/jp (404). File: content/regions/jp.md line 48. (autofix not possible)
Nina K: Heads-up — legal needs to sign off on wording for 'data stored in JP region'. I'll ping legal@ and loop in @Yuki.
Marcus L: I can update python + node snippets in this PR if y'all want. Will add a comment in the PR with diffs.
Elaine R: That would be great. Also please remove the deprecated alias mention in the overview paragraph.
Jordan P: For Node snippet I'll use:
```
const client = new RedwoodClient({region: 'ap-northeast-1', apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY});
```
Marcus L: PR updated with both snippets and table change. Also fixed link to legal page to point to /legal/data-residency/jp. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/492/files
docs-bot: CI: docs build passed on branch fix/geo-jp-492 :white_check_mark:
Nina K: Legal ack from Yuki: "fine with current phrasing as long as we link to the privacy notice." Added comment with link.
Elaine R: Perf — can someone merge after legal + one more approval? I'll cut a small follow-up for translations if needed.
Marcus L: I'll merge after one more review from Jordan and then hand off to i18n for Japanese update.
Jordan P: Reviewing now, will approve in ~15.
Elaine R: Thanks :thumbsup:
